column3: What does your software company do?
column4: We develop cloud-based software solutions that help businesses automate workflows, manage data, and scale operations efficiently.

column3: Where is your company headquartered?
column4: Our headquarters is located in San Francisco, CA, with regional offices in New York, London, and Singapore.

column3: How long has your company been in business?
column4: We were founded in 2012, giving us over a decade of experience building enterprise-grade software solutions.

column3: What industries do you serve?
column4: We serve Finance, Healthcare, Retail, Logistics, Education, Manufacturing, and SaaS companies worldwide.

column3: How many customers do you currently have?
column4: We proudly serve over 10,000 businesses globally, ranging from startups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

column3: Is your company publicly traded?
column4: We are a privately held company backed by leading venture capital firms. We do not currently trade on public markets.

column3: What is your company's mission?
column4: Our mission is to empower businesses with intelligent software tools that drive growth, efficiency, and innovation.

column3: Do you have a partner or reseller program?
column4: Yes, we offer a certified partner program. Visit our Partners page or email partners@company.com to apply.

column3: How can I contact customer support?
column4: You can reach support via live chat on our website, email support@company.com, or call +1-800-555-0199 (Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM EST).

column3: Do you have a physical product catalog?
column4: All our products are digital/cloud-based. You can browse the full product catalog on our website at company.com/products.

column3: What products do you offer?
column4: We offer four core products: CloudManager (infrastructure), DataSync (integration), InsightBoard (analytics), and TeamFlow (collaboration).

column3: What is CloudManager?
column4: CloudManager is our cloud infrastructure management platform that lets you deploy, monitor, and scale cloud resources from a single dashboard.

column3: What is DataSync?
column4: DataSync is a no-code data integration tool that connects 200+ data sources, enabling real-time data pipelines without any coding.

column3: What is InsightBoard?
column4: InsightBoard is our business intelligence and analytics platform offering drag-and-drop dashboards, predictive analytics, and automated reporting.

column3: What is TeamFlow?
column4: TeamFlow is a project and team collaboration tool featuring task boards, time tracking, document sharing, and built-in video conferencing.

column3: Do your products integrate with each other?
column4: Yes, all four products are natively integrated on our unified platform, allowing seamless data sharing and single sign-on across all tools.

column3: Does your software support mobile devices?
column4: Yes, all our products have fully featured iOS and Android mobile apps available on the App Store and Google Play.

column3: Is your software available offline?
column4: TeamFlow and InsightBoard offer limited offline mode. Full functionality requires an internet connection for real-time sync.

column3: What programming languages does your API support?
column4: Our REST API supports any language. We provide official SDKs for Python, JavaScript, Java, Ruby, PHP, Go, and .NET.

column3: Do you offer white-label or custom branding options?
column4: Yes, our Enterprise plan includes full white-label options, allowing you to apply your brand logo, colors, and custom domain.

column3: What pricing plans do you offer?
column4: We offer four plans: Starter (Free), Growth ($49/mo), Professional ($149/mo), and Enterprise (custom pricing).

column3: Is there a free trial available?
column4: Yes! Every plan comes with a 14-day free trial with full feature access. No credit card is required to start.

column3: What is included in the free Starter plan?
column4: The Starter plan includes up to 3 users, 5 GB storage, basic analytics, and access to TeamFlow and DataSync with limited connectors.

column3: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan anytime?
column4: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your account settings. Changes take effect on the next billing cycle.

column3: Do you offer annual billing discounts?
column4: Yes, choosing annual billing saves you 20% compared to monthly billing on all paid plans.

column3: Are there discounts for nonprofits or educational institutions?
column4: Yes, we offer a 40% discount for verified nonprofits and a 50% discount for accredited educational institutions.

column3: Is there a student discount?
column4: Yes, students with a valid .edu email address can access our Growth plan at 70% off through our Student Program.

column3: What payment methods do you accept?
column4: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), PayPal, bank wire transfer, and invoicing for Enterprise plans.

column3: Can I get a custom quote for my enterprise team?
column4: Absolutely. Contact our sales team at sales@company.com or book a demo to receive a tailored Enterprise quote.

column3: Do you charge per user or per company?
column4: Starter and Growth plans are charged per user seat. Professional and Enterprise plans offer team-based pricing with volume discounts.

column3: How do I create an account?
column4: Visit company.com/signup, enter your email address, set a password, and follow the onboarding steps. Setup takes under 2 minutes.

column3: How do I reset my password?
column4: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page. A reset link will be sent to your registered email within 1–2 minutes.

column3: Can I have multiple users under one account?
column4: Yes. You can invite team members from Settings > Team Management and assign them roles (Admin, Editor, or Viewer).

column3: How do I update my billing information?
column4: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods to update your credit card or billing details at any time.

column3: Where can I view my invoices?
column4: All invoices are available in Settings > Billing > Invoices. You can download PDF copies for your records.

column3: What happens when my trial ends?
column4: When your 14-day trial ends, your account moves to the free Starter plan. You won't lose your data, but some features will be restricted.

column3: How do I cancel my subscription?
column4: Go to Settings > Billing > Subscription and click 'Cancel Plan.' Your access continues until the end of the current billing period.

column3: Do you offer refunds?
column4: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. Contact billing@company.com with your request and order number.

column3: Can I transfer my account to another person?
column4: Yes, the account owner can transfer ownership via Settings > Account > Transfer Ownership. The new owner must verify by email.

column3: What happens to my data if I cancel?
column4: Your data is retained for 90 days after cancellation. You can export all data before the retention period expires.

column3: How do you protect my data?
column4: We use AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. All data is stored in SOC 2 Type II certified data centers.

column3: Is your platform GDPR compliant?
column4: Yes, we are fully GDPR compliant. We act as a Data Processor and provide a Data Processing Agreement (DPA) for all customers.

column3: Are you HIPAA compliant?
column4: Yes, we offer HIPAA-compliant configurations for healthcare customers on our Professional and Enterprise plans with a signed BAA.

column3: Do you support Single Sign-On (SSO)?
column4: Yes, we support SSO via SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and integration with Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and OneLogin.

column3: Do you offer two-factor authentication (2FA)?
column4: Yes, 2FA is available for all users via authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) or SMS. It is enforced on Enterprise plans.

column3: Where is my data stored?
column4: Data is stored in AWS data centers in the US, EU, and APAC regions. You can select your preferred region during setup.

column3: Do you conduct regular security audits?
column4: Yes, we conduct annual third-party penetration tests and maintain ongoing vulnerability scanning. Reports are available on request.

column3: Do you sell my data to third parties?
column4: No, we never sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing or advertising purposes.

column3: How do I submit a GDPR data subject request?
column4: Submit your request at company.com/privacy/dsr or email privacy@company.com. We respond within 30 days as required by law.

column3: What is your data breach notification policy?
column4: In the event of a breach affecting personal data, we notify affected customers within 72 hours in accordance with GDPR and applicable laws.

column3: What third-party tools do you integrate with?
column4: We integrate with 300+ tools including Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Zoom, Jira, GitHub, and Stripe.

column3: Do you have a Zapier integration?
column4: Yes, we are available on Zapier with 50+ triggers and actions. Search for our company name in the Zapier app directory.

column3: Do you support Webhooks?
column4: Yes, all plans support outbound Webhooks for real-time event notifications to your own systems or third-party tools.

column3: Is there a native Salesforce integration?
column4: Yes, our native Salesforce integration syncs contacts, deals, and activities bidirectionally in real time. Available on Growth plan and above.

column3: Can I connect to my own database?
column4: Yes, DataSync supports direct connections to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, and Snowflake databases.

column3: Do you have a Slack integration?
column4: Yes, you can receive real-time notifications, create tasks, and run quick commands directly from Slack using our Slack app.

column3: Is there a Google Sheets integration?
column4: Yes, InsightBoard can import/export data from Google Sheets and automatically sync on a schedule you define.

column3: Do you offer API access on all plans?
column4: API access is available on Growth and above. The Starter free plan includes read-only API access with a 1,000 request/day limit.

column3: What is the API rate limit?
column4: Growth: 10,000 requests/day; Professional: 100,000/day; Enterprise: custom limits. Rate limit headers are included in every response.

column3: Do you have an integration marketplace?
column4: Yes, visit company.com/marketplace to browse all available integrations, partner apps, and certified connectors.

column3: What is your platform's uptime SLA?
column4: We guarantee 99.9% uptime on Growth and Professional plans, and 99.99% uptime with priority SLA on Enterprise plans.

column3: Where can I check the platform status?
column4: Real-time status and incident history are available at status.company.com. You can also subscribe to email/SMS status alerts.

column3: What browsers are supported?
column4: We support the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported.

column3: What are the minimum system requirements?
column4: Any modern browser on Windows 10+, macOS 10.14+, or Ubuntu 18.04+. Mobile apps require iOS 14+ or Android 9+.

column3: How fast is your data sync?
column4: DataSync processes real-time events in under 500ms. Scheduled batch syncs run every 15 minutes on Growth, 5 minutes on Professional/Enterprise.

column3: What is the maximum file upload size?
column4: File upload limits: Starter 25 MB, Growth 100 MB, Professional 500 MB, Enterprise 5 GB per file.

column3: Do you support custom domains?
column4: Yes, custom domains are available on Professional and Enterprise plans. Setup instructions are in our Help Center.

column3: Do you offer on-premise deployment?
column4: An on-premise/private cloud deployment option is available exclusively for Enterprise customers. Contact sales for details.

column3: How do you handle database backups?
column4: We perform automated daily backups with 30-day retention. Enterprise customers can request point-in-time recovery (PITR).

column3: Do you offer a sandbox or staging environment?
column4: Yes, Professional and Enterprise plans include a separate sandbox environment for testing changes before deploying to production.

column3: What onboarding support do you provide?
column4: All new customers get access to our interactive onboarding wizard, video tutorials, and Help Center. Paid plans include live chat support.

column3: Is there a dedicated account manager?
column4: Dedicated Customer Success Managers are assigned to Professional (shared) and Enterprise (dedicated) plan customers.

column3: Do you offer training or certification programs?
column4: Yes! We offer free self-paced courses on company.com/academy. Certification exams are available for individual users and organizations.

column3: What is your support response time?
column4: Starter: community forums only. Growth: email (24 hrs). Professional: live chat + email (4 hrs). Enterprise: 24/7 phone + 1-hr SLA.

column3: Do you offer implementation services?
column4: Yes, our Professional Services team provides implementation, data migration, custom configuration, and training services for an additional fee.

column3: Is there a community forum or user group?
column4: Yes, join our community at community.company.com to connect with 50,000+ users, share tips, and access member-only resources.

column3: Can I import data from my current tool?
column4: Yes, we support data import from CSV, Excel, JSON, and direct migration from common tools like Asana, Trello, Monday.com, and HubSpot.

column3: Do you offer a guided product demo?
column4: Yes! Book a free 30-minute live demo with one of our product specialists at company.com/demo.

column3: Where can I find documentation and tutorials?
column4: Comprehensive documentation, API references, and video tutorials are available at docs.company.com.

column3: How do I report a bug or submit a feature request?
column4: Report bugs via the in-app 'Help > Report Issue' button. Submit feature requests at feedback.company.com or vote on existing ideas.

column3: What custom features can Enterprise customers request?
column4: Enterprise customers can request custom integrations, dedicated infrastructure, bespoke analytics modules, and tailored SLAs.

column3: Is there a minimum contract length for Enterprise?
column4: Enterprise agreements are typically annual. Multi-year contracts are available with additional discounts.

column3: Do you support multi-tenant architecture for large organizations?
column4: Yes, our platform supports multi-tenant architecture with isolated workspaces, custom roles, and organization-level billing.

column3: Can we get custom data retention policies?
column4: Yes, Enterprise customers can configure data retention from 30 days to 7 years depending on compliance requirements.

column3: Do you offer audit logs?
column4: Yes, full audit logs with user activity, data access, and configuration changes are available on Professional and Enterprise plans.

column3: Can we deploy in a private cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP)?
column4: Yes, Enterprise customers can opt for a dedicated private cloud deployment on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

column3: Do you support role-based access control (RBAC)?
column4: Yes, RBAC is available on all paid plans. Enterprise plans support custom role creation with granular permission sets.

column3: What compliance certifications do you hold?
column4: We are certified for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS. Certificates are available on request.

column3: Can we negotiate custom pricing for volume licenses?
column4: Yes, volume and multi-year pricing are negotiable for teams of 50+ users. Contact sales@company.com for a custom proposal.

column3: Do you have a Service Level Agreement (SLA) document?
column4: Yes, our standard SLA is available at company.com/legal/sla. Enterprise SLAs are fully negotiable and documented in the contract.

column3: Do you have a changelog or release notes?
column4: Yes, all product updates, new features, and bug fixes are published at company.com/changelog. Subscribe for email notifications.

column3: How often do you release product updates?
column4: We deploy minor updates weekly and major feature releases monthly. All updates are backward-compatible unless otherwise noted.

column3: Can I request a feature that does not exist yet?
column4: Absolutely! Submit feature requests at feedback.company.com. Our product team reviews all submissions and prioritizes by user votes.

column3: Do you have an affiliate or referral program?
column4: Yes, our referral program gives you $50 account credit for every customer you refer who upgrades to a paid plan.

column3: What accessibility standards does your platform meet?
column4: Our platform conforms to WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards, ensuring usability for people with disabilities.

column3: Is your platform available in multiple languages?
column4: Yes, our interface is available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, and Arabic.

column3: Do you have a public roadmap?
column4: Yes, our public product roadmap is available at company.com/roadmap. You can view planned features and upvote what matters most to you.

column3: How do I delete my account permanently?
column4: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. Data is permanently purged after 90 days. This action is irreversible.

column3: Can I use your software for personal projects?
column4: Yes, the free Starter plan is available for personal use. There are no restrictions on the type of projects you create.

column3: How do I stay updated on news and releases?
column4: Follow us on LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and YouTube, or subscribe to our monthly newsletter at company.com/newsletter.
